about_the_game:
About the game:

As an explorer, you will come to an unknown sea areas and lost land, where many dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures live. They are not extinct and have formed a unique ecological environment. You need to collect resources, build shelters, craft weapons, and fight against ferocious dinosaurs.

Game features:

  • Male and female character customization system, freely customize your appearance, makeup, age, weight, and various clothing
  • Supports single player and multiplayer mode, you can survive and explore with friends
  • Wide variety of dinosaurs and prehistoric creatures, high quality model and realistic animations.
  • Make weapons to hunt dinosaurs

[/*]

  • A vast open world map, based on realistic scan plant models and natural landscapes.

  • Dynamic day and night cycle system and weather changes, 3D clouds
    • [/list]

name: Dinosaur World

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Dinosaur World is a survival game about dinosaurs.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
